# Test fixtures

Everything under this directory is **test data**. None of it is generated by
Throughline, and none of it may be consumed as pipeline input or presented as
system output.

## `pp20/artefacts/`

Hand-written reference artefacts for the PP20 benchmark, conforming to the
canonical contract in `ontology/artefact-contract.yaml`. They exist so the
Tier-0 gate has realistic, passing input to validate.

These files were authored by a human. They are **not** evidence that Throughline
can produce artefacts — no code in this repository writes an artefact. Quoting
them as system output would be a false claim.

They cover 7 of the 49 artefacts the kernel plans for PP20.

## `broken/`

Deliberately malformed artefacts. Every file here **must be rejected** by
`scripts/gates/validate_artifact.py`. Each one probes a specific false positive,
several of which the pre-repair gate accepted — notably
`headings-only-no-frontmatter.md`, which contained nothing but headings and the
word "assumed" and was accepted as a valid solution recommendation.

`tests/test_gate.py` asserts that each file fails, and that it fails for the
specific declared reason rather than by accident.
